echo-10: Map mode, Raw, beam and sensitivity
The settings panel shows Raw, beam and 34% sensitivity; the map and profile are at roughly 24 m.
Compare tracks using the same settings. The material of the bottom is not visible.
echo-052343: A continuous bright bottom line around 15 m with several faint marks above it.
Do not identify targets from one frame; repeat the pass.
echo-052350: The 0% sensitivity, Fish Icons and palette settings are open; the bottom line is strong.
Settings alter the visibility of echoes. Do not compare density with an image made under different settings.
echo-052356: Fish Icons, depth range and palette
The icon, depth-range and palette panel is open at a reading near 23 m.
Icons do not identify species. Return to Raw to examine structure.
echo-052456: An almost level bottom line near 10 m and faint marks above it.
They may be targets, suspended matter or interference. Scan again.
echo-052504: Two large arch-like marks above the bottom line at a reading near 33 m.
A target return or motion artefact; one frame does not confirm the number or species of fish.
echo-052509: A patch of returns about 4–7 m above the bottom at a depth reading of 12.6 m.
Possible targets or interference; check on a repeat pass.
echo-052519: Many upright returns above an uneven bottom at a depth reading of 3.6 m.
Consistent with vegetation or obstacles, but type is uncertain. Scan across the feature.
echo-052535: The bottom line dips toward the middle and rises again around 8–10 m.
Mark the edges and make a cross pass. Colour alone proves neither gravel nor silt.
echo-052547: The bottom falls from left to around 5 m, with protruding returns along the slope.
Compare top, side and base. Returns may be structure or vegetation.
echo-052558: A compact group of echoes in the water column above a gentle slope around 10 m.
Do not identify a species; compare two tracks and settings.
echo-052608: Raised feature and changing bottom line
Nearly level bottom with a rise and a local change in echo thickness around 9 m.
Bottom material needs comparison at unchanged settings and a lead check.
echo-052614: Several arch shapes overlap above a flat bottom around 7.2 m.
Shape depends on movement and time in the beam. Do not infer species.
echo-052656: The bottom rises sharply toward about 2 m; another line is visible below.
It could be a multiple echo on the slope. Repeat in the opposite direction.
echo-052745: A simplified profile, green band above bottom and an icon near a slope.
The icon is the app's interpretation. Compare Raw and check with a lead.
echo-052754: Several icons over a depression, with upright green returns along its sides.
Icons confirm neither species nor bottom hardness.
echo-052802: Bottom dips toward the centre and rises on the right, with icons above the hollow.
Compare a safe side and the base, checking for snags.
